info.name: qTest Manager API Version 3.0 Test Run API

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of the project

params.name: parentId
params.description:
ID of the container (Release, Test Cycle or Test Suite)

Input 0 (zero) to retrieve Test Runs directly under root

params.name: parentType
params.description: Type of the container. Valid values include root, release, test-cycle and test-suite

params.name: expand
params.description: Specify expand=descendants to include all Test Runs which are directly or indirectly under the container

params.name: includeToscaProperties
params.description: By default, Tosca properties of Test Run (imported from Tosca) are not included in the response. Specify includeToscaProperties=true to include them. (tosca_guid, tosca_node_path, tosca_workspace_url, tosca_testevent_guid)

params.name: page
params.description: By default the first page is returned but you can specify any page number to retrieve objects

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The result is paginated. By the default, the number of objects in each page is 100 if this is omitted. You can specify your custom number (up to 999) in this parameter
